BiblicalUsage: Shihor is the stream of Egypt that marks the border of the promised land, the river of Egypt from which David gathers Israel, and the harvest of the river that fills the markets of Tyre. Jeremiah asks what Israel has to do with drinking the waters of Shihor.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Shihor is the edge of the world Israel knew, and the border God drew is the one I trust. I hold that drinking from Egypt's river is the question Jeremiah asks every generation.
